critical path, 1957 james kelley of remington rand and morgan walker of dupont modelled plant construction and shutdowns as activities joined by logic, on one of the early commercial computers. the longest chain set the finish date, and everything else had float. they also used it to work out which activities to speed up, for the least extra cost, to finish earlier. cpm gave dates a reason. it
